title: Blessing of Shadow
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Blessing of Shadow · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1274729318
body:
← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Silence

Tier 1Cost 1

You are immune to all power word spells. You also cannot be commanded to take an action by magical verbal commands.

Full original wording

The sheer force of spoken command washes over you harmlessly, as if your soul is shielded by a silence no word can penetrate. You are immune to all power word spells. You also cannot be commanded to take an action by magical verbal commands.

Tier 2Cost 2

Creatures that rely on tremorsense or blindsight to see you can no longer see you.

Full original wording

You glide over the ground without leaving a trace, unseen even to those who listen to the earth’s heartbeat. Creatures that rely on tremorsense or blindsight to see you can no longer see you.

Tier 3Cost 3

You may cast spells ignoring verbal components

Full original wording

Where others must speak to summon their power, you simply will it into being, wordless and unstoppable. You may cast spells ignoring verbal components

Theme 2

The Mystic

Tier 1Cost 1

Once per day, you may use your reaction to take your turn before any enemy within 120 feet. After doing so you are stunned until the start of your next turn.

Full original wording

Temporal Instinct: In the chaos of war, your mind is a razor—cutting through doubt, hesitation, and fear to strike with perfect, unyielding resolve. Once per day, you may use your reaction to take your turn before any enemy within 120 feet. After doing so you are stunned until the start of your next turn.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per short rest, when you take damage, you can use your reaction to become heavily obscured until the end of your next turn.

Full original wording

Umbral Instinct:The shadows answer your call, weaving a veil of darkness around you that absorbs blows and confounds attackers. Once per short rest, when you take damage, you can use your reaction to become heavily obscured until the end of your next turn.

Tier 3Cost 3

If a spell requires sight, and you know the creature's name, you can use their name in place of seeing them. This feature can be legendarily resisted. Distance requirements still apply.

Full original wording

You need no sight, no mark—only the sacred name, and your magic answers the call. If a spell requires sight, and you know the creature's name, you can use their name in place of seeing them. This feature can be legendarily resisted. Distance requirements still apply.

Theme 3

The Tranquil

Tier 1Cost 1

When you expend any number of hit dice to heal, once per short rest, you may use the maximum value instead of rolling. There is no limit to the amount of hit dice you may use.

Full original wording

In the sanctuary of your mind, your body finds the peace it needs to heal, closing wounds as if time itself bends to your will. When you expend any number of hit dice to heal, once per short rest, you may use the maximum value instead of rolling. There is no limit to the amount of hit dice you may use.

Tier 2Cost 2

If you roll below a 5 on a Wisdom saving throw, you may treat that roll as a 5.

Full original wording

Your mind has walked through shadows deeper than fear itself. No charm, illusion, or intrusion can pierce what darkness has already made whole. If you roll below a 5 on a Wisdom saving throw, you may treat that roll as a 5.

Tier 3Cost 3

You are immune to magical affects that would destroy your body, and the Revivify spell requires no material components on you.

Full original wording

Your mortal coil is a vessel touched by shadow, and the darkness within mends and preserves it like sacred fire in the eternal shadows. You are immune to magical affects that would destroy your body, and the Revivify spell requires no material components on you.

Compare the full rules in a table
